m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Flee this place, Shadow Blight! The Celestial Crab is ours.
Greeting, Wizard. I have been reduced by the Shadow for an age. I owe you a great debt.
You wish for pure Starstuff? The heavens are still scarred by the Shadow, and remain starless.
I retrieved this extinguished Starstuff from the bottom of the deep. This is what I can give you. I hope it will help.
<ITALICS>The chunk of Starstuff the Celestial Crab gives you is heavy, cold, and inert. You hope Amelia has a plan. </ITALICS>
You found the Celestial Crab held by Deep Spawn? The horror! It is a wonder that you were able to rescue him.
Let me see what he gave you. I see. Cold. Heavy. Wet. Inert. It will do.
There are four towers, each pledged to one aspect of the Celestial Zodiac. Cross over to the Nova Tower of the Celestial Crab.
Defeat whatever monsters have taken over the tower, and search for any sign of the Celestial Crab.
If you find him, tell the great power that we need pure Starstuff.
Go to the Celestial Crab Tower and search for the Celestial Crab. If you find him, ask him for some pure Starstuff.
